We have an internal AI capability library at `meta-skill-generator/` that's gotten messy over time. There are 5 new capabilities sitting unregistered in `meta-skill-generator/skills-library/` (subfolders: data-validator, code-reviewer, report-builder, log-analyzer, api-tester). I need a full quality audit:

1. Scan and register all those new capabilities into our tracking system.
2. Run sandbox tests on each new capability, then evaluate and score them.
3. Any capability scoring below the quality threshold needs to be automatically optimized.
4. Produce a single consolidated file called `audit_report.json` that summarizes everything: which capabilities were scanned, their evaluation scores, and any optimizations that were applied.

All the tooling we need is already built — check the project's documentation and scripts directory. The databases may have stale data from previous runs, so make sure the new capabilities get properly integrated.
